+        emitted_comments: set[str] = set()
+        for item in staged:
+            row_num = item["row_num"]
+            record = item["record"]
+            fields = parsed_fields[row_num]
+            business_id = str(record["original_record_id"]).strip() if record["original_record_id"] is not None else ""
+            if business_id and business_id not in conflicts:
+                comment_id = canonical_by_business_id[business_id]
+            else:
+                comment_id = stable_id("FB", source["source_version"], "row", row_num, business_id)
+            record["feedback_comment_id"] = comment_id
+            if comment_id not in emitted_comments:
+                bundle.feedback_comments.append({
+                    "id": comment_id,
+                    "source_file_id": source["id"],
+                    "source_version": source["source_version"],
+                    "original_id": business_id or None,
+                    **fields,
+                    "original_text": fields["text"],
+                    "text_quality": _text_quality(fields["text"]),
+                    "text_length": len(fields["text"]),
+                    "canonicalization": "source_version_plus_original_id" if business_id and business_id not in conflicts else "source_row_fallback",
+                })
+                emitted_comments.add(comment_id)
+            comment_text_quality = _text_quality(fields["text"])
+            # ``text_quality`` belongs to the emitted comment payload, not to
+            # the parsed workbook fields. Keep the warning test based on the
+            # same computed value without requiring a nonexistent field.
+            if comment_text_quality == "low_information_candidate":
+                bundle.issues.append({
+                    "severity": "warning",
+                    "code": "low_information_text_candidate",
+                    "source_file_id": source["id"],
+                    "source_record_id": record["id"],
+                    "message": "Source row is retained; downstream discovery may exclude it after review.",
+                })
+
+            if any(fields.get(name) for name in ("feedback_type", "vfc2", "vfc3")):
+                annotation_id = stable_id("ANN", record["id"], 0)
+                bundle.feedback_annotations.append({
+                    "id": annotation_id,
+                    "feedback_id": comment_id,
+                    "source_record_id": record["id"],
+                    "source_file_id": source["id"],
+                    "feedback_type_original": fields["feedback_type"],
+                    "vfc2_original": fields["vfc2"],
+                    "vfc3_original": fields["vfc3"],
+                    "assignment_method": "imported_annotation",
+                    "assignment_review": "unreviewed",
+                    "polarity": _polarity(fields["feedback_type"]),
+                })
+        bundle.source_files.append(dict(source))
+        row_counts: dict[str, int] = {}
+        comment_ids: dict[str, set[str]] = {}
+        for item in staged:
+            model = parsed_fields[item["row_num"]].get("model") or "unknown"
+            row_counts[model] = row_counts.get(model, 0) + 1
+            business_id = str(item["record"].get("original_record_id") or "").strip()
+            if business_id and business_id not in conflicts:
+                canonical_id = canonical_by_business_id[business_id]
+            else:
+                canonical_id = stable_id("FB", source["source_version"], "row", item["row_num"], business_id)
+            comment_ids.setdefault(model, set()).add(canonical_id)
+        bundle.manifest = {
+            "source_file_id": source["id"],
+            "kind": "feedback",
+            "sheet": sheet.title,
+            "header_row": header_row,
+            "source_rows": len(staged),
+            "canonical_comments": len(bundle.feedback_comments),
+            "annotations": len(bundle.feedback_annotations),
+            "duplicate_id_conflicts": len(conflicts),
+            "model_counts": {model: {"source_rows": row_counts[model],
+                                     "canonical_comments": len(comment_ids.get(model, set()))}
+                             for model in sorted(row_counts)},
+        }
+        return bundle
+    finally:
+        wb.close()
+
+
+def _polarity(feedback_type: Any) -> str | None:
+    key = normalize_header(feedback_type)
+    if key in {"like", "likes", "positive", "positivefeedback"}:
+        return "positive"
+    if key in {"difficulttouse", "dtu", "defect", "negative", "negativefeedback"}:
+        return "negative"
+    if key in {"wants", "request", "featurewish"}:
+        return "request"
+    return None
+
+
+def _numeric(value: Any) -> int | float | None:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or value is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, (int, float, Decimal)):
+        numeric = float(value)
+        if not math.isfinite(numeric):
+            return None
+        return int(numeric) if numeric.is_integer() else numeric
+    if isinstance(value, str):
+        text = value.strip().replace(",", "")
+        if not text or not re.fullmatch(r"[-+]?(?:\d+(?:\.\d*)?|\.\d+)(?:[eE][-+]?\d+)?", text):
+            return None
+        number = float(text)
+        return int(number) if number.is_integer() else number
+    return None
+
+
+def _year(value: Any) -> int | None:
+    text = str(value or "").strip()
+    # Underscores count as word characters, so ``volume_2030`` does not have
+    # a ``\b`` before the year. Treat non-digits as valid delimiters.
+    match = re.search(r"(?<!\d)(20(?:24|25|30))(?!\d)", text)
+    return int(match.group(1)) if match else None
+
+
+def _region(value: Any) -> str | None:
+    mapped, _ = _normalize_region(value, value)
+    return mapped
+
+
+def _line(value: Any) -> str | None:
+    compact = normalize_header(value)
+    if "g60g68" in compact or ("g60" in compact and "g68" in compact):
+        return "G60_G68"
+    for code in ("F70", "G60", "G68", "G70"):
+        if normalize_header(code) in compact:
+            return code
+    return None
+
+
+def _scope_from_text(values: Iterable[Any]) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
+    joined = " ".join(str(value) for value in values if value is not None)
+    line = _line(joined)
+    # In native study input, G68_CN remains derivative G68; only the sales
+    # line parser maps the combined G60_G68 line.
+    model = "G68" if re.search(r"(?i)\bG68\s*[_-]\s*CN\b", joined) else line
+    region = None
+    for candidate, aliases in {
+        "US": ("United States", "USA", "US"),
+        "CN": ("China", "CN"),
+        "EU": ("Europe", "EU", "United Kingdom", "Norway", "GB"),
+        "RoW": ("Rest of World", "RoW"),
+    }.items():
+        if any(re.search(rf"(?i)(?<![A-Za-z]){re.escape(alias)}(?![A-Za-z])", joined) for alias in aliases):
+            region = candidate
+            break
+    return model, region
+
+
+def _survey_column_scope(row: Mapping[str, Any], column_index: int) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]:
+    """Resolve model/market from this column's headings, including merged cells."""
+    header_values = row.get("header_values", [])
+    column_header = header_values[column_index] if column_index < len(header_values) else None
+    model = _line(column_header)
+    model_headers = {candidate for value in header_values if (candidate := _line(value))}
+    fallback_model, fallback_region = _scope_from_text([row.get("sheet")])
+    if model is None and len(model_headers) <= 1:
+        model = fallback_model or next(iter(model_headers), None)
+
+    region = None
+    for context_row in row.get("record", {}).get("raw_payload", {}).get("header_context", []):
+        values = context_row.get("values", [])
+        nearest_region = None
+        # Merged spreadsheet headings leave continuation cells blank. Carry a
+        # region label across those columns, stopping at the next explicit one.
+        for index in range(min(column_index + 1, len(values))):
+            candidate = _region(values[index])
+            if candidate:
+                nearest_region = candidate
+        if nearest_region:
+            region = nearest_region
+    if region is None:
+        region = fallback_region
+    return model, region
+
+
+def _headers_and_records(path: Path, source: Mapping[str, Any], bundle: ConversionBundle) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    openpyxl = _excel_module()
+    # Keep formula text in the source record while also reading Excel's cached
+    # result for numeric facts. openpyxl does not calculate formulas itself.
+    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=False)
+    cached_wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(path, read_only=True, data_only=True)
+    rows: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    try:
+        for sheet_index, sheet in enumerate(wb.worksheets):
+            cached_sheet = cached_wb.worksheets[sheet_index]
+            width = sheet.max_column
+            # A title/merged heading often precedes the table. Prefer the
+            # densest of the first 20 populated rows, while retaining every
+            # populated row with its original locator below.
+            populated = [(n, [cell.value for cell in sheet[n]])
+                         for n in range(1, min(sheet.max_row, 20) + 1)
+                         if _nonempty(cell.value for cell in sheet[n])]
+            def header_score(values: Sequence[Any]) -> tuple[float, int, int]:
+                nonempty_count = sum(1 for value in values if value is not None and str(value).strip())
+                score = 0.0
+                for value in values:
+                    if value is None:
+                        continue
+                    normalized = normalize_header(value)
+                    if any(normalized in aliases for aliases in HEADER_ALIASES.values()):
+                        score += 4
+                    # Product/derivative headings are the column schema in
+                    # BMW's wide study sheets, even when no literal "model"
+                    # header exists.
+                    if _line(value):
+                        score += 6
+                    if _year(value) is not None or _region(value) is not None:
+                        score += 2
+                    if normalized in {str(number) for number in range(1, 8)}:
+                        score += 1
+                    if any(label in normalized for label in
+                           ("satisfied", "dissatisfied", "agree", "disagree", "important", "quality", "rating")):
+                        score += 1
+                return score, nonempty_count, -len(values)
+
+            header_row = max(populated, key=lambda item: header_score(item[1]))[0] if populated else 1
+            headers = _header_map([cell.value for cell in sheet[header_row]])
+            header_values = [cell.value for cell in sheet[header_row]]
+            header_context = [
+                {"row": row_num, "values": [json_value(value) for value in values]}
+                for row_num, values in populated if row_num <= header_row
+            ]
+            question_label = (str(header_values[0]).strip()
+                              if header_values and header_values[0] is not None else None)
+            # Iterate the read-only worksheet once instead of calling
+            # ``sheet.cell`` for every cell, which repeatedly scans the XML.
+            formula_rows = sheet.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=sheet.max_row,
+                                           min_col=1, max_col=width, values_only=True)
+            cached_rows = cached_sheet.iter_rows(min_row=1, max_row=sheet.max_row,
+                                                 min_col=1, max_col=width, values_only=True)
+            for row_num, (values, cached_values) in enumerate(
+                    zip(formula_rows, cached_rows, strict=True), start=1):
+                cells = list(values)
+                cached_cells = list(cached_values)
+                if not _nonempty(cells):
+                    continue
+                source_record = _row_source_record(source, sheet.title, row_num, headers, cells)
+                source_record["raw_payload"]["header_context"] = header_context
+                source_record["record_kind"] = "table_header" if row_num == header_row else "original_row"
+                bundle.source_records.append(source_record)
+                if row_num <= header_row:
+                    continue
+                first_value = cells[0] if cells else None
+                has_numeric = any(
+                    _effective_numeric(value, cached_cells[index] if index < len(cached_cells) else None)[0] is not None
+                    for index, value in enumerate(cells)
+                )
+                measure_label = (str(first_value).strip()
+                                 if has_numeric and first_value is not None and str(first_value).strip()
+                                 else None)
+                if not has_numeric and first_value is not None and str(first_value).strip():
+                    question_label = str(first_value).strip()
+                rows.append({"sheet": sheet.title, "row_num": row_num, "headers": headers,
+                             "header_values": header_values, "cells": cells,
+                             "cached_cells": cached_cells, "question_label": question_label,
+                             "measure_label": measure_label, "record": source_record})
+    finally:
+        wb.close()
+        cached_wb.close()
+    return rows
+
+
+def _effective_numeric(raw_value: Any, cached_value: Any) -> tuple[int | float | None, str]:
+    """Return a numeric source value and whether it came from a formula cache."""
+    if isinstance(raw_value, str) and raw_value.startswith("="):
+        return _numeric(cached_value), "cached_formula_result"
+    return _numeric(raw_value), "source_numeric_cell"
+
+
+def _fact(source: Mapping[str, Any], record: Mapping[str, Any], kind: str,
+          locator: Mapping[str, Any], **properties: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
+    fact_id = stable_id("FACT", source["id"], kind, json.dumps(locator, sort_keys=True), properties.get("metric"), properties.get("value"))
+    return {
+        "id": fact_id,
+        "source_file_id": source["id"],
+        "source_record_id": record["id"],
+        "source_version": source["source_version"],
+        "kind": kind,
+        "locator": dict(locator),
+        **properties,
+    }
+
+
+def _convert_survey_rows(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], source: Mapping[str, Any], bundle: ConversionBundle) -> None:
+    for row in rows:
+        headers, cells = row["headers"], row["cells"]
+        cached_cells = row.get("cached_cells", cells)
+        respondent_n_value = _numeric(_alias_value(headers, cells, "respondent_n"))
+        respondent_n = int(respondent_n_value) if respondent_n_value is not None and respondent_n_value >= 0 else None
+        raw_scale = _alias_value(headers, cells, "scale")
+        scale = str(raw_scale).strip() if raw_scale is not None and str(raw_scale).strip() else None
+        raw_unit = _alias_value(headers, cells, "unit")
+        # Some BMW sheets put a measure label such as "% of column, sample
+        # base" in the second cell rather than a named column.
+        if raw_unit is None and len(cells) > 1 and isinstance(cells[1], str):
+            raw_unit = cells[1]
+        unit = str(raw_unit).strip() if raw_unit is not None and str(raw_unit).strip() else None
+        question = row.get("question_label")
+        measure_label = row.get("measure_label")
+        numeric_cells = []
+        for index, raw_value in enumerate(cells):
+            cached_value = cached_cells[index] if index < len(cached_cells) else None
+            value, value_provenance = _effective_numeric(raw_value, cached_value)
+            if value is not None:
+                numeric_cells.append((index, value, value_provenance))
+        if not numeric_cells:
+            continue
+        # Preserve every numeric cell as a native fact, including scales and
+        # percentages. No cross-scale averaging or respondent-N inference.
+        for index, value, value_provenance in numeric_cells:
+            column_header = headers[index] if index < len(headers) else f"column_{index + 1}"
+            model, region = _survey_column_scope(row, index)
+            metric_parts = [part for part in (question, measure_label) if part]
+            metric = " / ".join(dict.fromkeys(metric_parts)) or str(column_header)
+            cell_locator = {**row["record"]["locator"], "column": index + 1,
+                            "column_header": column_header}
+            bundle.facts.append(_fact(
+                source, row["record"], "survey_cell", cell_locator,
+                metric=metric, question=question, response_label=measure_label,
+                value=value, unit=unit, scale=scale,
+                derivative=model, region=region, respondent_n=respondent_n,
+                interpretation="native_cell_unmapped", mapping_strength="unmapped",
+                source_value=json_value(cells[index]), value_provenance=value_provenance,
+            ))
+
+        # Recognize a seven-column 1..7 distribution only when those native
+        # category labels are explicit in the workbook header.
+        category_positions: list[int] = []
+        for index, header in enumerate(row["header_values"]):
+            if str(header).strip() in {"1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6", "7"}:
+                category_positions.append(index)
+        if len(category_positions) == 7 and category_positions == list(range(category_positions[0], category_positions[0] + 7)):
+            values = [
+                _effective_numeric(
+                    cells[index] if index < len(cells) else None,
+                    cached_cells[index] if index < len(cached_cells) else None,
+                )[0]
+                for index in category_positions
+            ]
+            if all(value is not None for value in values):
+                question_labels = [str(value).strip() for value in cells[:category_positions[0]]
+                                   if isinstance(value, str) and str(value).strip()]
+                question = " / ".join(question_labels) or row["sheet"]
+                distribution = {str(row["header_values"][index]): value
+                                for index, value in zip(category_positions, values)}
+                locators = [{**row["record"]["locator"], "column": index + 1,
+                             "column_header": str(row["header_values"][index])}
+                            for index in category_positions]
+                bundle.facts.append(_fact(
+                    source, row["record"], "survey_distribution",
+                    {**row["record"]["locator"], "cells": locators},
+                    metric=question, question=question, distribution=distribution,
+                    distribution_total=sum(values), distribution_kind="native_unclassified", unit=unit,
+                    category_labels=[str(row["header_values"][index]) for index in category_positions],
+                    respondent_n=respondent_n,
+                    scale=scale or "1-7 (explicit native category headers)",
+                    scale_provenance="explicit_source_column" if scale else "derived_from_explicit_category_headers",
+                    derivative=model, region=region,
+                    mapping_strength="unmapped",
+                    note="Seven native categories preserved; total is not interpreted as respondent N.",
+                ))
+
+    _add_native_survey_distributions(rows, source, bundle)
+
+
+def _add_native_survey_distributions(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]],
+                                     source: Mapping[str, Any], bundle: ConversionBundle) -> None:
+    """Bundle seven source response rows without inventing N or a mapped topic."""
+    grouped: dict[tuple[str, str, str, str], list[dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+    for row in rows:
+        category = row.get("measure_label")
+        cells = row["cells"]
+        cached_cells = row.get("cached_cells", cells)
+        if not category or normalize_header(category) in {"sampletotal", "mean"}:
+            continue
+        source_measure = cells[1] if len(cells) > 1 and isinstance(cells[1], str) else ""
+        if "%" not in source_measure and "percent" not in source_measure.casefold():
+            continue
+        for index, raw_value in enumerate(cells):
+            cached_value = cached_cells[index] if index < len(cached_cells) else None
+            value, value_provenance = _effective_numeric(raw_value, cached_value)
+            if value is None:
+                continue
+            model, region = _survey_column_scope(row, index)
+            if not model or not region:
+                continue
+            key = (str(row["sheet"]), str(row.get("question_label") or ""), model, region)
+            grouped.setdefault(key, []).append({
+                "category": str(category), "value": value, "value_provenance": value_provenance,
+                "row": row, "column": index,
+            })
+
+    for (sheet, question, model, region), entries in grouped.items():
+        categories = [entry["category"] for entry in entries]
+        if len(entries) != 7 or len(set(categories)) != 7:
+            continue
+        total = sum(entry["value"] for entry in entries)
+        if not (abs(total - 1.0) <= 0.03 or abs(total - 100.0) <= 3.0):
+            continue
+        ordered = sorted(entries, key=lambda entry: entry["row"]["row_num"])
+        first = ordered[0]
+        locators = []
+        for entry in ordered:
+            entry_row = entry["row"]
+            column_index = entry["column"]
+            column_header = (entry_row["header_values"][column_index]
+                             if column_index < len(entry_row["header_values"]) else None)
+            locators.append({
+                **entry_row["record"]["locator"],
+                "source_record_id": entry_row["record"]["id"],
+                "column": column_index + 1,
+                "column_header": json_value(column_header),
+                "response_category": entry["category"],
+                "value_provenance": entry["value_provenance"],
+            })
+        unit = first["row"]["cells"][1] if len(first["row"]["cells"]) > 1 else None
+        bundle.facts.append(_fact(
+            source, first["row"]["record"], "survey_distribution",
+            {"filename": source["filename"], "sheet": sheet, "question": question, "cells": locators},
+            metric=question, question=question,
+            distribution={entry["category"]: entry["value"] for entry in ordered},
+            distribution_total=total, distribution_kind="native_seven_category",
+            category_labels=[entry["category"] for entry in ordered],
+            respondent_n=None, scale=None, scale_provenance="not_reported",
+            unit=unit, derivative=model, region=region,
+            mapping_strength="unmapped",
+            note="Native seven-category shares; sample base is not interpreted as respondent N.",
+            cell_locators=locators,
+        ))
+
+
+def _convert_sales_rows(rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]], source: Mapping[str, Any], bundle: ConversionBundle) -> None:
+    for row in rows:
+        headers, cells = row["headers"], row["cells"]
+        cached_cells = row.get("cached_cells", cells)
+        header_context = row["record"].get("raw_payload", {}).get("header_context", [])
+        context_values = [value for context_row in header_context for value in context_row.get("values", [])]
+        context = [row["sheet"], source["filename"], *cells, *row["header_values"], *context_values]
+        context_years = {_year(value) for value in context_values if _year(value)}
+        context_regions = {_region(value) for value in context_values if _region(value)}
+        line = _line(" ".join(str(value) for value in context if value is not None))
+        # Prefer explicit long-table columns if present.
+        explicit_year = _alias_value(headers, cells, "year")
+        explicit_volume = _alias_value(headers, cells, "volume")
+        explicit_region = _alias_value(headers, cells, "region")
+        explicit_line = _alias_value(headers, cells, "model")
+        if explicit_line:
+            line = _line(explicit_line) or line
+        if explicit_year is not None and explicit_volume is not None and explicit_region is not None:
+            year = _year(explicit_year)
+            region = _region(explicit_region)
+            volume_index = next((index for index, header in enumerate(headers)
+                                 if normalize_header(header) in HEADER_ALIASES["volume"]), None)
+            cached_volume = cached_cells[volume_index] if volume_index is not None and volume_index < len(cached_cells) else None
+            volume, value_provenance = _effective_numeric(explicit_volume, cached_volume)
+            if year and region and line and volume is not None:
+                bundle.facts.append(_fact(
+                    source, row["record"], "sales", row["record"]["locator"],
+                    vehicle_line=line, derivative=None, region=region, year=year,
+                    volume=volume, unit="vehicles", powertrain=None,
+                    powertrain_split="unknown", applicability="whole_line",
+                    mapping_version="sales_line_map_v1",
+                    source_value=json_value(explicit_volume), value_provenance=value_provenance,
+                ))
+                continue
+
+        # Matrix layout: year/region may be on either the row or column header.
+        for index, raw_value in enumerate(cells):
+            cached_value = cached_cells[index] if index < len(cached_cells) else None
+            volume, value_provenance = _effective_numeric(raw_value, cached_value)
+            if isinstance(raw_value, str) and raw_value.startswith("=") and volume is None:
+                bundle.issues.append({
+                    "severity": "warning", "code": "sales_formula_without_cached_value",
+                    "source_file_id": source["id"], "source_record_id": row["record"]["id"],
+                    "column": index + 1,
+                    "message": "Formula text was preserved, but the workbook has no cached numeric result to use as a sales fact.",
+                })
+            if volume is None:
+                continue
+            column_label = row["header_values"][index] if index < len(row["header_values"]) else None
+            # In matrix layouts an exact 2024/2025/2030 cell can be a row
+            # label. Keep it in the raw row and use it as context for sibling
+            # volume cells, rather than importing it as a vehicle volume.
+            if (_year(raw_value) is not None and volume == _year(raw_value)
+                    and _year(column_label) is None):
+                continue
+            row_values = [value for value in cells if value is not None]
+            year = (_year(column_label) or next((_year(value) for value in row_values if _year(value)), None)
+                    or (next(iter(context_years)) if len(context_years) == 1 else None))
+            region = (_region(column_label) or next((_region(value) for value in row_values if _region(value)), None)
+                      or (next(iter(context_regions)) if len(context_regions) == 1 else None))
+            if not (line and year and region):
+                continue
+            locator = {**row["record"]["locator"], "column": index + 1,
+                       "column_header": json_value(column_label)}
+            bundle.facts.append(_fact(
+                source, row["record"], "sales", locator,
+                vehicle_line=line, derivative=None, region=region, year=year,
+                volume=volume, unit="vehicles", powertrain=None,
+                powertrain_split="unknown", applicability="whole_line",
+                mapping_version="sales_line_map_v1",
+                source_value=json_value(raw_value), value_provenance=value_provenance,
+            ))
+
+
+def convert_workbook(path: Path, kind: str, source: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None) -> ConversionBundle:
+    """Convert study or sales workbook while retaining every populated row."""
+    source = dict(source or _source_file(path, kind, None))
+    bundle = ConversionBundle(source_files=[source])
+    rows = _headers_and_records(path, source, bundle)
+    if not rows:
+        raise ConversionError("Workbook contains no populated source rows")
+    if kind == "survey":
+        _convert_survey_rows(rows, source, bundle)
+        if not bundle.facts:
+            bundle.issues.append({"severity": "error", "code": "survey_no_numeric_facts",
+                                  "source_file_id": source["id"],
+                                  "message": "Workbook rows were preserved, but no numeric study cells could be converted."})
+    elif kind == "sales":
+        _convert_sales_rows(rows, source, bundle)
+        if not any(fact.get("kind") == "sales" for fact in bundle.facts):
+            bundle.issues.append({"severity": "error", "code": "sales_no_scoped_facts",
+                                  "source_file_id": source["id"],
+                                  "message": "Workbook rows were preserved, but no sales value had an identifiable line, region, and year."})
+    else:
+        for row in rows:
+            for index, value in enumerate(row["cells"]):
+                if _numeric(value) is None:
+                    continue
+                locator = {**row["record"]["locator"], "column": index + 1}
+                bundle.facts.append(_fact(source, row["record"], "workbook_numeric_cell", locator,
+                                          metric=row["headers"][index] if index < len(row["headers"]) else None,
+                                          value=_numeric(value), interpretation="unmapped"))
+    bundle.manifest = {
+        "source_file_id": source["id"], "kind": kind,
+        "source_rows": len(rows), "facts": len(bundle.facts),
+        "unmapped_numeric_cells": sum(1 for fact in bundle.facts if fact.get("mapping_strength") == "unmapped"),
+    }
+    return bundle
+
+
+def _chunk_page_text(text: str, max_words: int = 850) -> list[tuple[int, int, str]]:
+    spans = list(re.finditer(r"\S+", text))
+    chunks: list[tuple[int, int, str]] = []
+    for offset in range(0, len(spans), max_words):
+        group = spans[offset:offset + max_words]
+        if not group:
+            continue
+        start, end = group[0].start(), group[-1].end()
+        chunks.append((start, end, text[start:end]))
+    return chunks
+
+
+def convert_pdf(path: Path, source: Mapping[str, Any] | None = None,
+                document_kind: str | None = None) -> ConversionBundle:
+    """Extract page-preserving PDF text and exact per-page chunk substrings."""
+    document_kind = document_kind or classify_source(path)[1] or "document"
+    source = dict(source or _source_file(path, "document", document_kind))
+    bundle = ConversionBundle(source_files=[source])
+    reader = _pdf_reader(path)
+    if len(reader.pages) == 0:
+        raise ConversionError("PDF contains no pages")
+    page_summaries: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
+    for page_number, page in enumerate(reader.pages, start=1):
+        try:
+            text = page.extract_text() or ""
+        except Exception as exc:  # preserve per-page failures, continue safely
+            text = ""
+            bundle.issues.append({"severity": "error", "code": "pdf_page_extraction_failed",
+                                  "source_file_id": source["id"], "page": page_number,
+                                  "message": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"})
+        record_id = stable_id("SR", source["id"], "page", page_number)
+        record = {
+            "id": record_id, "source_file_id": source["id"],
+            "source_version": source["source_version"],
+            "locator": {"filename": source["filename"], "page": page_number, "printed_page": None},
+            "raw_payload": {"text": text, "extraction": "pypdf", "page_text_empty": not bool(text.strip())},
+            "original_record_id": None,
+        }
+        bundle.source_records.append(record)
+        chunk_count = 0
+        for chunk_number, (start, end, chunk_text) in enumerate(_chunk_page_text(text), start=1):
+            chunk_id = stable_id("DOC", source["id"], page_number, chunk_number, start, end)
+            bundle.document_chunks.append({
+                "id": chunk_id, "source_file_id": source["id"],
+                "source_record_id": record_id, "source_version": source["source_version"],
+                "document_kind": document_kind, "page": page_number, "printed_page": None,
+                "chunk_number": chunk_number, "start_offset": start, "end_offset": end,
+                "original_text": chunk_text, "derivative": None, "market": None,
+                "applicability": "unknown",
+            })
+            chunk_count += 1
+        if not text.strip():
+            bundle.issues.append({"severity": "error", "code": "pdf_page_empty_or_unextractable",
+                                  "source_file_id": source["id"], "page": page_number,
+                                  "message": "Page retained with an empty text record; citation text is unavailable."})
+        page_summaries.append({"page": page_number, "characters": len(text), "chunks": chunk_count})
+    bundle.manifest = {"source_file_id": source["id"], "kind": "document",
+                       "document_kind": document_kind, "pages": page_summaries,
+                       "page_count": len(page_summaries), "chunks": len(bundle.document_chunks)}
+    return bundle
+
+
+def _merge_bundle(target: ConversionBundle, source: ConversionBundle) -> None:
+    for field_name in ("source_files", "source_records", "feedback_comments", "feedback_annotations",
+                       "facts", "document_chunks", "issues"):
+        getattr(target, field_name).extend(getattr(source, field_name))
+    target.manifest.setdefault("sources", []).append(source.manifest)
+
+
+def discover_sources(raw_data_dir: Path) -> list[Path]:
+    if not raw_data_dir.exists() or not raw_data_dir.is_dir():
+        raise ConversionError(f"Raw data directory does not exist or is not a directory: {raw_data_dir}")
+    return sorted((path for path in raw_data_dir.rglob("*") if path.is_file()
+                   and not path.name.startswith("~$")
+                   and path.suffix.casefold() in SUPPORTED_EXCEL | SUPPORTED_PDF),
+                  key=lambda item: str(item.relative_to(raw_data_dir)).casefold())
+
+
+EXPECTED_FEEDBACK_COUNTS = {
+    "F70": {"source_rows": 4076, "canonical_comments": 2128},
+    "G60": {"source_rows": 5005, "canonical_comments": 4000},
+    "G70": {"source_rows": 4690, "canonical_comments": 4000},
+}
+
+
+def convert_sources(raw_data_dir: Path, required_kinds: Sequence[str] = DEFAULT_REQUIRED_KINDS,
+                    check_known_feedback_counts: bool = False,
+                    required_document_kinds: Sequence[str] = DEFAULT_REQUIRED_DOCUMENT_KINDS) -> ConversionBundle:
+    """Convert supported files without writing to, renaming, or deleting inputs."""
+    raw_data_dir = raw_data_dir.resolve()
+    paths = discover_sources(raw_data_dir)
+    if not paths:
+        raise ConversionError("No supported XLSX/XLSM/PDF inputs found; no empty success bundle was produced")
+    bundle = ConversionBundle()
+    source_kinds: set[str] = set()
+    seen_source_ids: dict[str, str] = {}
+    for path in paths:
+        kind, document_kind = classify_source(path)
+        try:
+            source = _source_file(path, kind, document_kind)
+            prior_kind = seen_source_ids.get(source["id"])
+            if prior_kind is not None:
+                severity = "warning" if prior_kind == kind else "error"
+                bundle.issues.append({"severity": severity,
+                                      "code": "duplicate_source_content_skipped",
+                                      "filename": path.name, "source_file_id": source["id"],
+                                      "kind": kind, "prior_kind": prior_kind,
+                                      "message": "Identical file content is imported once per SHA-256; duplicate path skipped."})
+                continue
+            seen_source_ids[source["id"]] = kind
+            if kind == "feedback":
+                converted = convert_feedback_workbook(path, source)
+            elif kind in {"survey", "sales", "workbook"}:
+                converted = convert_workbook(path, kind, source)
+            elif kind == "document":
+                converted = convert_pdf(path, source, document_kind)
+            else:
+                bundle.issues.append({"severity": "warning", "code": "unsupported_source",
+                                      "filename": path.name, "message": "Input extension is not supported."})
+                continue
+            source_kinds.add(kind)
+            _merge_bundle(bundle, converted)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            bundle.issues.append({"severity": "error", "code": "source_conversion_failed",
+                                  "filename": path.name, "kind": kind,
+                                  "message": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"})
+
+    missing_kinds = sorted(set(required_kinds) - source_kinds)
+    for kind in missing_kinds:
+        bundle.issues.append({"severity": "error", "code": "required_input_kind_missing",
+                              "kind": kind, "message": f"No successfully converted source of kind '{kind}' was found."})
+    available_document_kinds = sorted({
+        str(source.get("document_kind")) for source in bundle.source_files
+        if source.get("kind") == "document" and source.get("document_kind")
+    })
+    missing_document_kinds = sorted(set(required_document_kinds) - set(available_document_kinds))
+    for document_kind in missing_document_kinds:
+        bundle.issues.append({
+            "severity": "error", "code": "required_document_kind_missing",
+            "document_kind": document_kind,
+            "message": f"No successfully converted document of kind '{document_kind}' was found.",
+        })
+    successful_source_count = len(bundle.source_files)
+    observed_feedback: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = {}
+    for source_summary in bundle.manifest.get("sources", []):
+        if source_summary.get("kind") != "feedback":
+            continue
+        for model, model_counts in source_summary.get("model_counts", {}).items():
+            observed = observed_feedback.setdefault(model, {"source_rows": 0, "canonical_comments": 0})
+            observed["source_rows"] += int(model_counts.get("source_rows", 0))
+            observed["canonical_comments"] += int(model_counts.get("canonical_comments", 0))
+    known_count_check = {}
+    for model, expected in EXPECTED_FEEDBACK_COUNTS.items():
+        observed = observed_feedback.get(model)
+        known_count_check[model] = {
+            "expected": expected,
+            "observed": observed,
+            "status": "not_present" if observed is None else ("matches" if observed == expected else "mismatch"),
+        }
+        if check_known_feedback_counts and observed is not None and observed != expected:
+            bundle.issues.append({"severity": "error", "code": "feedback_count_acceptance_mismatch",
+                                  "model": model, "expected": expected, "observed": observed,
+                                  "message": "Observed counts differ from the documented complete-export target."})
+    if check_known_feedback_counts:
+        for model in EXPECTED_FEEDBACK_COUNTS:
+            if model not in observed_feedback:
+                known_count_check[model]["status"] = "not_present"
+                bundle.issues.append({"severity": "error", "code": "feedback_count_acceptance_model_missing",
+                                      "model": model,
+                                      "message": "Complete-export acceptance check requested but no feedback source for this model was found."})
+    if check_known_feedback_counts and any(issue.get("severity") == "error" for issue in bundle.issues):
+        status = "partial" if successful_source_count else "failed"
+    if successful_source_count == 0:
+        status = "failed"
+    elif missing_kinds or missing_document_kinds or any(issue["severity"] == "error" for issue in bundle.issues):
+        status = "partial"
+    else:
+        status = "succeeded"
+    bundle.manifest.update({
+        "conversion_version": CONVERSION_VERSION,
+        "status": status,
+        "required_kinds": list(required_kinds),
+        "required_document_kinds": list(required_document_kinds),
+        "available_kinds": sorted(source_kinds),
+        "available_document_kinds": available_document_kinds,
+        "missing_kinds": missing_kinds,
+        "missing_document_kinds": missing_document_kinds,
+        "known_feedback_count_check_enabled": check_known_feedback_counts,
+        "known_feedback_counts": known_count_check,
+        "sources": bundle.manifest.get("sources", []),
+        "counts": {
+            "source_files": len(bundle.source_files),
+            "source_records": len(bundle.source_records),
+            "feedback_comments": len(bundle.feedback_comments),
+            "feedback_annotations": len(bundle.feedback_annotations),
+            "facts": len(bundle.facts),
+            "document_chunks": len(bundle.document_chunks),
+            "issues": len(bundle.issues),
+        },
+        "issues": bundle.issues,
+    })
+    return bundle
+
+
+def _write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> None:
+    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
+        for row in rows:
+            stream.write(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), default=json_value))
+            stream.write("\n")
+
+
+def write_bundle(bundle: ConversionBundle, output_dir: Path, raw_data_dir: Path) -> Path:
+    """Write a versioned intermediate bundle outside the raw source directory."""
+    output_dir = output_dir.resolve()
+    raw_data_dir = raw_data_dir.resolve()
+    if output_dir == raw_data_dir or raw_data_dir in output_dir.parents:
+        raise ConversionError("Output directory must be outside the raw data directory; originals are immutable")
+    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    tables = {
+        "source_files.jsonl": bundle.source_files,
+        "source_records.jsonl": bundle.source_records,
+        "feedback_comments.jsonl": bundle.feedback_comments,
+        "feedback_annotations.jsonl": bundle.feedback_annotations,
+        "facts.jsonl": bundle.facts,
+        "document_chunks.jsonl": bundle.document_chunks,
+    }
+    for filename, rows in tables.items():
+        _write_jsonl(output_dir / filename, rows)
+    manifest_path = output_dir / "manifest.json"
+    manifest_path.write_text(json.dumps(bundle.manifest, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+    return manifest_path

+"""Opt-in end-to-end checks against a disposable, loopback Neo4j instance."""

+
+import os
+from pathlib import Path

+import unittest
+from urllib.parse import urlparse
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+from openpyxl import Workbook
+
+from config import get_settings
+from services.evidence import EvidenceScope, Neo4jEvidenceProvider
+from services.ingestion import convert_sources, write_bundle
+
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+REAL_DATA_DIR = get_settings().raw_data_dir
+NEO4J_URI = os.environ.get("BMW_NEO4J_TEST_URI")
+
+
+class LiveNeo4jTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    """Import the real source set and prove scoped evidence reads with Neo4j."""
+
+    @classmethod
+    def setUpClass(cls) -> None:
+        if not NEO4J_URI:
+            raise unittest.SkipTest("set BMW_NEO4J_TEST_URI to run live Neo4j integration checks")
+        host = urlparse(NEO4J_URI).hostname
+        if host not in {"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1"}:
+            raise RuntimeError("Live integration tests only write to a loopback Neo4j instance")
+        try:
+            from neo4j import GraphDatabase
+        except ImportError as exc:
+            raise RuntimeError("Install the Neo4j Python driver from pipeline/requirements-data.txt") from exc
+
+        if os.environ.get("BMW_NEO4J_TEST_AUTH_DISABLED") == "1":
+            auth = None
+        else:
+            settings = get_settings()
+            user = os.environ.get("BMW_NEO4J_TEST_USER", settings.neo4j_user)
+            password = os.environ.get("BMW_NEO4J_TEST_PASSWORD", settings.neo4j_password.get_secret_value())
+            if not user or not password:
+                raise RuntimeError(
+                    "Set BMW_NEO4J_TEST_USER and BMW_NEO4J_TEST_PASSWORD, or use a loopback test DB "
+                    "with BMW_NEO4J_TEST_AUTH_DISABLED=1"
+                )
+            auth = (user, password)
+        cls.driver = GraphDatabase.driver(NEO4J_URI, auth=auth)
+        cls.driver.verify_connectivity()
+
+    @classmethod
+    def tearDownClass(cls) -> None:
+        if getattr(cls, "driver", None) is not None:
+            cls.driver.close()
+
+    def _loader(self):
+        from importlib.util import spec_from_file_location, module_from_spec
+
+        spec = spec_from_file_location("bmw_data_loader", REPO_ROOT / "pipeline" / "01_load_neo4j.py")
+        assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
+        loader = module_from_spec(spec)
+        spec.loader.exec_module(loader)
+        return loader
+
+    def _graph_snapshot(self) -> dict:
+        with self.driver.session() as session:
+            nodes = session.run(
+                "MATCH (n) RETURN labels(n) AS labels, count(n) AS count ORDER BY labels"
+            ).data()
+            relationships = session.run(
+                "MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN type(r) AS type, count(r) AS count ORDER BY type"
+            ).data()
+        return {"nodes": nodes, "relationships": relationships}

+    def test_import_and_audit_failure_roll_back_new_evidence(self) -> None:

+                bundle.source_files, bundle.source_records, bundle.feedback_comments, bundle.feedback_annotations
+            ) for row in table] + [token]
+
+            def probe_count() -> int:
+                with self.driver.session() as session:
+                    return session.run(
+                        "MATCH (n) WHERE n.id IN $ids OR n.vfc2 = $topic RETURN count(n) AS count",
+                        ids=probe_ids, topic=token,
+                    ).single()["count"]
+
+            self.assertEqual(probe_count(), 0)
+
+            def failing_audit_sink(tx, event) -> None:

+        self.assertEqual(first, second)

+        self.assertEqual(first["counts"]["feedback_comments"], 10_128)
+        self.assertEqual(first["counts"]["feedback_annotations"], 13_371)
+        self.assertGreater(first["counts"]["document_chunks"], 78)

+        with self.driver.session() as session:

+        self.assertGreater(graph_counts["strategy_chunk_count"], 0)
+        with self.driver.session() as session:
+            current_import_runs = session.run(
+                "MATCH (run:ImportRun {id: $id}) RETURN count(run) AS count",
+                id=first["import_run_id"],
+            ).single()["count"]
+        self.assertEqual(current_import_runs, 1)
+
+        provider = Neo4jEvidenceProvider(self.driver)
+        sample = next(comment for comment in bundle.feedback_comments
+                      if comment.get("model") == "G70" and comment.get("region") == "US"
+                      and comment.get("original_text", "").strip())
+        searchable_words = re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9_'-]{6,}", sample["original_text"])
+        self.assertTrue(searchable_words, "Chosen feedback sample has no searchable word")
+        g70_us_texts = [comment.get("original_text", "").casefold()
+                        for comment in bundle.feedback_comments
+                        if comment.get("model") == "G70" and comment.get("region") == "US"]
+        query = min(searchable_words,
+                    key=lambda word: sum(word.casefold() in text for text in g70_us_texts))
+        matches = provider.search_feedback(query, EvidenceScope(model="G70", region="US"), limit=100)
+        sample_match = next((match for match in matches if match["id"] == sample["id"]), None)

+        self.assertEqual(sample_match["model_original"], "G70")

+        source_record_id = sample_match["source_records"][0]["id"]

+        self.assertIsNotNone(source_record)
+        self.assertTrue(source_record["locator"].get("row"))
+        self.assertIn(sample["original_text"], source_record["raw_payload"]["values_by_header"].values())
+
+        report_chunks = provider.search_document_chunks(
+            "BMW", document_kind="corporate_report", limit=3
+        )
+        self.assertTrue(report_chunks)
+        self.assertTrue(all(chunk["source_locator"].get("page") for chunk in report_chunks))
+        self.assertTrue(all(chunk["source_locator"]["filename"].lower().endswith(".pdf")

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import runpy
+import tempfile
+import unittest
+
+from config import get_settings
+from services.ingestion import convert_sources, write_bundle
+
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+REAL_DATA_DIR = get_settings().raw_data_dir
+_loader = runpy.run_path(str(REPO_ROOT / "pipeline" / "01_load_neo4j.py"))
+load_processed_bundle = _loader["load_processed_bundle"]
+BundleError = _loader["BundleError"]
+
+
+class _Result:
+    def consume(self):
+        return None
+
+
+class _Transaction:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.calls = []
+
+    def run(self, query, **params):
+        self.calls.append((query, params))
+        return _Result()
+
+
+class _Session:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.tx = _Transaction()
+
+    def __enter__(self):
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, exc_type, exc_value, traceback):
+        return False
+
+    def run(self, query, **params):
+        return self.tx.run(query, **params)
+
+    def execute_write(self, work):
+        return work(self.tx)
+
+
+class _Driver:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.session_value = _Session()
+
+    def session(self):
+        return self.session_value
+
+
+def _write_jsonl(path: Path, rows: list[dict]) -> None:
+    path.write_text("".join(json.dumps(row) + "\n" for row in rows), encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+class LoaderTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def _bundle_dir(self, root: Path, status: str = "succeeded") -> Path:
+        bundle_dir = root / "processed"
+        bundle_dir.mkdir()
+        (bundle_dir / "manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps({
+            "status": status,
+            "conversion_version": "test-1",
+            "counts": {"source_files": 1},
+        }), encoding="utf-8")
+        _write_jsonl(bundle_dir / "source_files.jsonl", [{
+            "id": "SRC-1", "sha256": "abc", "source_version": "abc",
+            "filename": "fixture.xlsx", "kind": "feedback",
+        }])
+        _write_jsonl(bundle_dir / "source_records.jsonl", [{
+            "id": "SR-1", "source_file_id": "SRC-1", "source_version": "abc",
+            "locator": {"sheet": "Feedback_Explorer", "row": 2},
+            "raw_payload": {"text": "A synthetic example."},
+            "feedback_comment_id": "FB-1",
+        }])
+        _write_jsonl(bundle_dir / "feedback_comments.jsonl", [{
+            "id": "FB-1", "source_file_id": "SRC-1", "source_version": "abc",
+            "model": "G70", "region": "US", "original_text": "A synthetic example.",
+        }])
+        _write_jsonl(bundle_dir / "feedback_annotations.jsonl", [{
+            "id": "ANN-1", "feedback_id": "FB-1", "source_record_id": "SR-1",
+            "feedback_type_original": "DTU",
+        }])
+        _write_jsonl(bundle_dir / "facts.jsonl", [{
+            "id": "FACT-1", "source_record_id": "SR-1", "kind": "sales", "volume": 0,
+        }])
+        _write_jsonl(bundle_dir / "document_chunks.jsonl", [{
+            "id": "DOC-1", "source_file_id": "SRC-1", "source_record_id": "SR-1",
+            "original_text": "synthetic",
+        }])
+        return bundle_dir
+
+    def test_bundle_import_batches_and_audit_share_one_transaction(self) -> None:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=REPO_ROOT) as temp_dir:
+            bundle_dir = self._bundle_dir(Path(temp_dir))
+            driver = _Driver()
+            audit_events = []
+
+            result = load_processed_bundle(
+                driver, bundle_dir,
+                audit_sink=lambda tx, event: audit_events.append((tx, event)),
+            )
+
+        self.assertEqual(result["status"], "succeeded")
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["source_files"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["feedback_comments"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["feedback_annotations"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["facts"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["document_chunks"], 1)
+        self.assertEqual(len(audit_events), 1)
+        self.assertIs(audit_events[0][0], driver.session_value.tx)
+        self.assertEqual(audit_events[0][1]["action"], "source_import")
+        self.assertGreater(len(driver.session_value.tx.calls), 1)
+
+    def test_partial_bundle_is_refused_without_explicit_override(self) -> None:
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=REPO_ROOT) as temp_dir:
+            bundle_dir = self._bundle_dir(Path(temp_dir), status="partial")
+
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(BundleError, "Refusing to import"):
+                load_processed_bundle(_Driver(), bundle_dir)
+
+    def test_real_bmw_bundle_serializes_and_passes_import_validation(self) -> None:
+        if not REAL_DATA_DIR.is_dir():
+            self.skipTest("private BMW-Data directory is not present")
+
+        bundle = convert_sources(REAL_DATA_DIR, check_known_feedback_counts=True)
+        self.assertEqual(
+            bundle.manifest["status"],
+            "succeeded" if not bundle.manifest["missing_document_kinds"] else "partial",
+        )
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(dir=REPO_ROOT) as temp_dir:
+            bundle_dir = Path(temp_dir) / "bundle"
+            write_bundle(bundle, bundle_dir, REAL_DATA_DIR)
+            driver = _Driver()
+            audit_events = []
+            result = load_processed_bundle(
+                driver, bundle_dir,
+                audit_sink=lambda tx, event: audit_events.append((tx, event)),
+                allow_partial=True,
+            )
+
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["source_files"], bundle.manifest["counts"]["source_files"])
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["source_records"], bundle.manifest["counts"]["source_records"])
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["feedback_comments"], 10_128)
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["feedback_annotations"], 13_371)
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["facts"], bundle.manifest["counts"]["facts"])
+        self.assertEqual(result["counts"]["document_chunks"], bundle.manifest["counts"]["document_chunks"])
+        self.assertEqual(len(audit_events), 1)
+        self.assertIs(audit_events[0][0], driver.session_value.tx)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

Start from `pipeline/study_topic_mappings.example.json`, add exact `fact_ids`, relation (`direct`, `broad`, `contradictory`, or `unmapped`), reason, reviewer, and review time, then load with `--study-mappings <file>`. Mappings to a fact from another converted bundle are rejected.

`services.evidence` exports `EvidenceScope`, typed DTOs, and the `search_feedback`, `get_source_record`, `get_survey_facts`, `get_sales_facts`, `search_document_chunks`, and `get_comment_cohort_counts` providers. Construct `Neo4jEvidenceProvider(driver)` or configure the application-scoped provider. Search results include stable IDs, source hash/version, original text/value, exact row/cell/page locator, applicable scope, and unknowns. Provider/database failures raise `EvidenceProviderError`; they are not returned as empty evidence.

Example service usage from the backend (the backend owns driver lifecycle):

```python
from services.evidence import EvidenceScope, Neo4jEvidenceProvider

provider = Neo4jEvidenceProvider(driver)
quotes = provider.search_feedback(
    "seat ventilation", EvidenceScope(model="G70", region="US"), limit=10
)
study = provider.get_survey_facts(
    "seat ventilation", EvidenceScope(model="G70", region="US")
)
```

Until the second call has a reviewed mapping, it returns an explicit `unmapped` state instead of treating a keyword match as corroboration. Use the quote's `source_records` locator or `get_source_record(id)` to resolve the original workbook row.

Counts distinguish unique canonical comments from annotations. Topic and issue counts are separate; broad bucket counts must not be reused as narrow issue support. Source A–D values stay opaque. `pipeline/02_build_kg.py` stores source-rate differences as descriptive records and same-VFC3 mixed polarity as a review candidate. It deliberately creates no formal preference-conflict edge: that requires a reviewed preference metric, not just a source-rate gap or opposing broad feedback labels.

## Acceptance targets and current limits

For the complete export, the documented feedback targets are F70 4,076 source rows/2,128 distinct IDs; G60 5,005/4,000; G70 4,690/4,000. Run the optional count check against the supplied sources before treating those counts as reproduced. The source workbooks and PDFs are not bundled in this code branch, so no actual count, source citation, parser output, or live Neo4j import has been claimed here.

The generic workbook adapters intentionally preserve uncertain layouts instead of claiming they have fully decoded every BMW workbook. In particular, native survey cells that lack recognizable seven-category headers remain raw cell facts; sales cells lacking an explicit line/region/year remain source rows. Such data must be inspected and mapped before it can support a specific requirement. Full corpus conversion and a Neo4j import/query review remain necessary when the private source files and database are available.

# Shared Environment Configuration

## One Configuration Contract

[.env.example](.env.example) defines the canonical runtime variables for all branches. Each developer copies it to a private root `.env` and supplies the OpenAI key. All application modules use root `config.py`; they do not create their own env files, aliases, dotenv loading, or copied endpoint/model/password/path defaults.

**OpenAI is the only LLM provider.** No `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, `CLAUDE_MODEL`, `LLM_API_KEY`, or provider-selection environment variable is required. A missing OpenAI key means live generation/review is unavailable; fixture tests, UI against a configured API, and non-model operations can still work. Do not silently select another provider.

This file and the template are the integration contract. The reviewed engine currently reads only part of it: new path/UI settings and OpenAI-only behavior must be wired through the existing `config.py`, runner and Compose by Role 3 with Roles 1/2/4. Creating `.env` alone does not implement those missing readers.

## Variables and Consumers

| Variable | Template default | Consumer / purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `OPENAI_API_KEY` | Empty; fill privately | Role 2's backend model adapter; required for live calls |
| `OPENAI_MODEL` | `gpt-4o-mini` | Model adapter; selected model recorded in run provenance |
| `BMW_RAW_DATA_DIR` | `./BMW-Data` | Role 1 raw XLSX/PDF conversion |
| `BMW_DATA_DIR` | `./var/processed` | Converter output and existing processed-input loader |
| `BMW_OUTPUT_DIR` | `./var/exports` | Role 3 sample/audit/freeze exports; Role 5 private delivery artifacts |
| `BMW_CACHE_DIR` | `./var/cache` | Role 2 private model/retrieval cache |
| `NEO4J_URI` | `bolt://localhost:7687` | Backend/data graph connection |
| `NEO4J_USER` | `neo4j` | Graph authentication; shared with Compose initialization |
| `NEO4J_PASSWORD` | `bmwpassword` | Existing local development password; shared with Compose |
| `API_HOST` | `0.0.0.0` | Backend listen address, not a UI destination |
| `API_PORT` | `8000` | Backend listen/published port |
| `API_BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:${API_PORT}` | Frontend API origin; dotenv resolves the port reference |
| `STREAMLIT_SERVER_ADDRESS` | `0.0.0.0` | Streamlit listen address |
| `STREAMLIT_SERVER_PORT` | `8501` | Streamlit listen/published port |

Weights, evidence thresholds, forecast/reference policy, allowed statuses and tool budgets belong to versioned application policy, not duplicate per-developer environment knobs. Actual source values are read from imported data.

## Local Setup

1. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` at the repository root.
2. Set `OPENAI_API_KEY` for the processes performing live AI calls. Frontend-only work can leave it empty and connect to a team backend through `API_BASE_URL`.
3. Put the supplied inputs in `BMW_RAW_DATA_DIR`; conversion produces files under `BMW_DATA_DIR`.
4. The launcher starts the backend and UI using these settings; jobs/exporters use the same root-resolved paths.

Root `config.py` must explicitly load the root `.env` with process-environment precedence (`override=False`). Resolve relative paths against the repository root, never a caller's current directory. Parse/validate ports and URLs centrally; require OpenAI credentials at the live-model boundary rather than breaking unrelated UI/fixture imports.

Do not load a separate `.env` from `pipeline/`, `services/`, or `ui/`. The loader may run once in each process; application modules import the resulting settings. Never include the key/password in diagnostic output.

## Container Wiring — Same Names, Different Network

Owner 3 adapts the existing Compose file using the root `.env`:

- API receives `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `OPENAI_MODEL`, Neo4j credentials, and data/output/cache settings. It connects to `NEO4J_URI=bolt://neo4j:7687` inside Compose.
- Neo4j initialization uses the same `NEO4J_USER`/`NEO4J_PASSWORD`; no second hard-coded credential declaration.
- UI receives `API_BASE_URL=http://api:${API_PORT}` plus native Streamlit server settings. It does not receive OpenAI credentials.
- Backend/Streamlit commands and published ports use the canonical values instead of conflicting hard-coded CLI overrides.
- Raw/processed/export/cache paths are mounted and overridden to the corresponding container paths using these same variable names. Raw files may be read-only; conversion/export/cache directories must be writable by their owning processes.
- Streamlit reads native server environment before its CLI initializes. The local launcher must export `STREAMLIT_SERVER_*` before starting it; loading dotenv only inside the already-running UI script is too late for custom server ports.

Compose service-host overrides describe container topology. They are not new configuration aliases or a second team env file. An API URL may intentionally point to a remote/shared backend, independently of the local backend bind address.

## Role Ownership

- **Role 1:** consumes raw/processed settings through config; supplies converter/manifest behavior.
- **Role 2:** consumes OpenAI/model/cache settings through config; removes legacy provider fallback/imports with Role 3.
- **Role 3:** owns the template, root config reader, startup validation, runner, Compose and environment integration tests. Changes to variable names go through this owner.
- **Role 4:** consumes API settings through the shared reader/client; renders UI and uses native Streamlit startup settings. No model keys or direct graph connection.
- **Role 5:** uses delivered export/presentation locations and startup instructions; no separate application settings.

## Integration Acceptance Checks

1. Template has one assignment per key and no real API key; `.env` and private outputs are ignored by Git.
2. Root config resolves the template paths from any working directory; process overrides win.
3. Changing `API_PORT` updates the local interpolated API origin unless an explicit remote `API_BASE_URL` is supplied.
4. OpenAI-only configuration produces a live model call after valid credentials are supplied. Empty credentials produce a clear unavailable result, never Anthropic fallback.
5. Native Streamlit address/port apply before server startup; UI connects locally and through the Compose service name.
6. Compose graph credentials match backend settings, and input/output/cache mounts have the intended read/write access.
7. All pipeline/API/UI modules import canonical settings; no `load_dotenv` or duplicated `os.getenv`/defaults appears outside the config/launcher boundary.

# Role 1 — Data Engineering & Evidence Provenance

## Exact Role

Own the transformation from BMW files to trustworthy, retrievable evidence. This is a data/backend specialty: **no frontend implementation and no model prompting**.

Success: import the real datasets, preserve every source/annotation, and return exact feedback spans, study cells, sales facts, and report pages through a stable Python provider.

Use this assignment with [the implementation plan](../IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md). The relevant branch findings and acceptance criteria are embedded below; [the original review](../AI_ENGINE_BRANCH_REVIEW.md) is supporting history. Baseline code is `origin/ai-requirements-engine` at reviewed snapshot `3bd0251`. This is the data-engineering part of the existing Neo4j/FastAPI/Streamlit application.

## Existing Code and File Ownership

| Own | Work |
| :--- | :--- |
| `pipeline/00_preprocess.py` | Replace the assumption of already-clean external JSON with documented raw-to-processed conversion; preserve originals |
| `pipeline/01_load_neo4j.py` | Source versions/locators, canonical comments, annotations, native facts, page-aware documents |
| `pipeline/02_build_kg.py`, `03_vfc_analysis.py` | Correct counts/relations; distinguish source-rate differences from actual conflicting preferences |
| New `services/evidence.py`, `services/ingestion.py` | Typed evidence-provider functions and conversion helpers |
| `tests/data/*` | Synthetic parser/provider tests and real-data count checks |

Supply source DTO/schema definitions to Role 3, who coordinates `models.py`, `config.py`, constraints and API entry points. Neo4j is the authoritative store. You define source nodes/relationships; Role 3 incorporates constraints and transaction infrastructure.

**Shared environment:** use root [.env.example](../.env.example) and [CONFIGURATION.md](../CONFIGURATION.md). Read `BMW_RAW_DATA_DIR`, `BMW_DATA_DIR` and graph settings through `config.py`; do not introduce `RAW_DATA_PATH`/`PROCESSED_DIR` aliases or your own dotenv/defaults. Relative paths resolve from the repository root.

### Branch Repairs Assigned to This Role

Task IDs match the repair backlog in the implementation plan. P0 repairs block the trustworthy judged demonstration. The hour-3 slice can start with real feedback while full heterogeneous conversion completes by hour 6; P1 repairs complete the sample/demo evidence.

| Task | Priority / ownership | Observed behavior at `3bd0251` | Implementation and acceptance proof |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **R07** | P0, lead; Role 2 consumes membership | `01_load_neo4j.py:43–59` MERGEs a comment and SETs one type; mixed annotations are overwritten. Signals only reach broad VFCs. | Separate source rows/annotations/comments; expose original IDs/locators and distinct counts. Mixed fixture retains both annotations; Role 2's issue references exact spans rather than every topic member. |
| **R08** | P0, lead | Steps 00/01 expect external clean JSON; raw XLSX/PDF conversion and corporate-report ingestion are absent. | Produce reproducible conversion/manifest and page-aware strategy/equipment text. From supplied raw files, import counts match source and a report-page citation resolves; missing files return an explicit incomplete/failed result. |
| **R14** | P1, lead | `01_load_neo4j.py:97–146` skips valid G68 input and drops study cells/native distributions. | Preserve source G68/CN, all native study evidence, cells and unknown sample metadata. G68_CN test remains G68; a US distribution remains seven categories with N unknown. |
| **R11** | P1, support Role 3 | Scoring constants use max 2025 market volume; G60/G70 RoW is zeroed. | Supply actual region/year/line facts, including 2030/RoW and G60_G68 mapping. Role 3 reproduces scoped reach from your fact IDs with no double counting or invented powertrain split. |
| **R12** | P1, support Role 3 | Source A–D semantics and a complaint-channel discount are assumed; confidence ignores source concentration. | Preserve opaque labels, mapping evidence and concentration/coverage summaries. Unsupported channel meanings are unknown, not imported truth. |
| **R13** | P1, support Role 2 | Keyword study matching and presumed scales/pooled regions can produce unjustified tier upgrades. | Supply reviewed issue-to-metric relations and native scale/region/derivative metadata; ambiguous matches remain broad/unmapped. |

### Evidence Baseline to Repair

The reviewed export has 250 proposals and 750 quote occurrences. **538** are exact substrings in the original feedback for the stated model; **212** are not. None of the source-signal exports contains original feedback IDs. Matching text alone does not prove the correct issue/category/source assignment; preprocessing may explain non-matches.

Work with Role 2 to produce a private lineage-validation result per occurrence: requirement/signal ID, quoted text, candidate original feedback IDs and source locators, transformation if documented, assignment review, and validation state. Multiple matches remain ambiguous until disambiguated. Never attach the first search hit just to make a citation pass. Preserve legacy artifacts; rebuild verified evidence from the raw source versions.

The review used mocked services; live Neo4j query/import behavior was not validated. Your handoff requires a real test-graph import/query check as well as fixture tests.

## Responsibilities

1. Convert supplied XLSX/PDF inputs reproducibly into a documented intermediate format/manifest.
2. Preserve raw rows, canonical comments and per-topic/type annotations separately.
3. Preserve native survey distributions, scale/sample metadata, and actual source derivative/region.
4. Expose real forecast facts instead of scoring constants.
5. Ingest equipment and strategy passages with original text and page anchors.
6. Supply distinct counts, coverage and search results; never model-generated counts.
7. Record source/consolidation-statistic versions and report missing/unreadable data.

## Interfaces and Handoffs

```python
search_feedback(query, scope, limit=20)
get_source_record(record_id)
get_survey_facts(topic, scope)
get_sales_facts(scope, year=2030)
search_document_chunks(query, scope, document_kind=None, limit=6)
get_comment_cohort_counts(scope)
```

Each result includes stable ID, source-file hash/version, original text/value, locator, source/target applicability metadata, and explicit unknowns. Workbook locators contain sheet/row/column; PDFs use 1-based physical page and optional printed page label. Preserve original and normalized powertrain/category values.

Role 2 calls these functions for extraction/retrieval. Role 3 wraps them in HTTP endpoints and uses them for scoring/validation. Role 4 consumes those endpoints, not your database code.

Use injected driver/transaction and an audit sink. Evidence imports record events within their transaction; the sink never commits independently. Independent tests can use fake repositories/sinks before a live Neo4j integration.

## Implementation Details

### Feedback

- Hash source files; import the same version idempotently.
- Read columns by header name. Retain every original row and its row number.
- Canonicalize by source version plus original ID; verify repeated IDs have consistent text/metadata.
- Model `CustomerFeedback` plus separate `FeedbackAnnotation` and `SourceRecord` nodes. A comment may have Likes and DTU annotations for different topics.
- Normalize BEVE to BEV without removing the source value. Document commercial-region mapping for GB/Norway/Europe.
- Flag low-information text; preserve meaningful short text. Missing labels remain unknown or separately inferred, not overwritten.
- Add explicit unique constraints through Role 3. Skip missing VFC3 nodes rather than MERGE on null properties.
- Count DISTINCT canonical IDs per cohort/topic/issue, never annotation edges or spans.

Expected source rows / canonical IDs: F70 **4,076 / 2,128**, G60 **5,005 / 4,000**, G70 **4,690 / 4,000**; total **13,771 / 10,128**. Distinct comments are not proven distinct customers.

### Studies and forecasts

- CN/EU category/Mean rows retain original cells, region and derivative. Preserve G68_CN as source G68; map G60/G68 only where the shared sales line warrants it.
- US seven-category distributions remain native. `Sample total = 1` means 100%, not N=1. Unknown N/scale stays null.
- Supply a reviewed topic/metric map with direct/broad/unmapped/contradictory relation and reason. A satisfaction difference does not establish an interface preference.
- Sales facts use unique vehicle-line/region/year. G60_G68 is one line. Preserve zero versus absent values and all supplied RoW volumes.
- No supplied powertrain split: expose whole-line forecast as a possible upper-bound proxy, not BEV volume.

### Documents and statistics

- Extract the option catalogs and `BMW-Group-Report-2025-en.pdf` page by page; chunk within pages and retain exact original text.
- Retain German equipment wording; translations are derived. German packages are not automatically valid in other markets.
- Use Neo4j full-text indexes or a deterministic bounded lexical provider behind your interface. Record extraction failures and verify showcase passages manually.
- Correct step 02/03 aggregation so annotation polarity is issue-specific. Keep opaque Source A–D labels unless their semantics are actually documented; do not assume Source C is a complaint channel.

## Shared Synthetic Fixture

Coordinate `contracts/fixture_case.json` with Role 3; all roles reuse these synthetic aliases.

| Row | Business ID / canonical alias | Scope | Annotation | Original text |
| ---: | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 2 | FIXTURE-001 / FB-FIXTURE-001 | G60, US, BEVE | Likes / Interior | I like the cabin, but temperature adjustment is hard to find. |
| 3 | FIXTURE-001 / FB-FIXTURE-001 | G60, US, BEVE | DTU / HVAC | I like the cabin, but temperature adjustment is hard to find. |
| 4 | FIXTURE-002 / FB-FIXTURE-002 | G60, US, BEVE | DTU / HVAC | Temperature adjustment is hard to find. |
| 5 | FIXTURE-003 / FB-FIXTURE-003 | G60, US, ICE | Likes / HVAC | Temperature adjustment is easy to find. |

Expected: four rows, three comments, four annotations. Role 2's fixture issue links two supporting comments and one positive counterexample. All-powertrain G60/US denominator is three.

Additional fixture IDs:
- FACT-FIXTURE-SURVEY-001: directly mapped independent HVAC-access rating distribution, seven categories totaling 1; respondent N unknown.
- FACT-FIXTURE-SALES-US and FACT-FIXTURE-SALES-EU: G60_G68 whole-line 2030 volumes 100 each; full fixture reference 200.
- CHUNK-FIXTURE-STRATEGY-001 and CHUNK-FIXTURE-OPTION-001: synthetic page-1 passages; option applicability explicitly Germany.

Production IDs are collision-resistant/source-versioned; a fixture alias map resolves the test IDs. Synthetic data must not be presented as BMW findings.

## Verify Correctness Independently

Planned command after integration scaffold:

```bash
python -m pytest tests/data
```

Use generated synthetic XLSX/PDF and fake repositories, then a test-only Neo4j namespace/database for real query verification.

| Test | Expected result |
| :--- | :--- |
| Duplicate ID/mixed annotations | Four rows → three comments/four annotations; both polarities survive |
| Reimport / new version | Same hash creates no duplicates; new version does not overwrite old evidence |
| Source resolution | Quote/value equals exact row/cell/page contents |
| G68 / US studies | G68 retained; native distributions preserved; unknown N not invented |
| Missing / zero / RoW sales | Missing stays missing, zero stays zero, source volumes match |
| Group counts | DISTINCT comment counts, no annotation/relationship inflation |
| Malformed wrapper / missing labels | Typed import report; no silent skip presented as success |
| No China free-text input | Coverage gap, not zero demand or inferred preference |
| Legacy quote reconciliation | Each used demo quote has an exact original ID/span/locator; transformed or ambiguous matches remain labeled and cannot be counted as verified support |
| Original run/input missing | No successful empty import; required inputs and failures appear in the manifest/run state |

Real check: run conversion/import on all supplied files, compare the count table, inspect one source per input kind, and hand over three verified quote/cell/page references for the demo. Live Neo4j behavior remains a separate check from mocked tests.

## Timeline and Definition of Done

- First 45 minutes: source contracts/fixture/mappings, data-path manifest and schema handoff.
- By hour 2: real feedback and exact source provider available.
- By hour 6: native studies/sales/documents and corrected cohort statistics.
- Hours 6–10: provenance and real-query checks; help Role 5 validate claims.

Handoff includes provider, processed-format manifest, fixture responses, passing tests, actual counts, verified citations and gaps. Keep raw/processed evidence, quotes, caches and exports private/ignored. Do not implement frontend screens; send example payloads to Role 4.
